lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Rose, please don't lose that tooth until I'm back. I want to see the hole.
lines.script: [softly, wistful] Rose, please don't lose that tooth until I'm back. I want to see the hole.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Then we have ten minutes! I'll take all ten. I have so much to tell you.
lines.script: [eager, warm] Then we have ten minutes! I'll take all TEN. I have so much to tell you.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A fish on Long Island jumped out of the water and froze in the air, inside one of those orange blocks. It's still hanging up there!
lines.script: [excited, amazed] A fish on Long Island jumped out of the water and froze in the air, inside one of those orange blocks. It's STILL hanging up there!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: It's just hanging in the air? Babe! That's a flying fish!
lines.script: [disbelief] It's just hanging in the air? [delighted, playful] Babe! That's a FLYING fish!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: And he's got more air time than you do.
lines.script: [teasing, easy] And he's got more air time than YOU do.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nobody has more air time than me. He's seven feet up. I was at thirty-six thousand.
lines.script: [indignant, proud] NOBODY has more air time than me. [precise] He's seven feet up. I was at thirty-six thousand.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: And my mother made a rule. Nobody in the family goes anywhere alone, and that goes for Los Angeles too.
lines.script: [serious, earnest] And my mother made a rule. Nobody in the family goes anywhere alone, and that goes for Los Angeles too.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Nobody in the family. Does that count me?
lines.script: [careful] Nobody in the family. [hopeful, quietly] Does that count me?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You were the first one I thought of.
lines.script: [warm, quick] You were the FIRST one I thought of.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Then it's a good thing I got you this.
lines.script: [warm, pleased] Then it's a good thing I got you this.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A lanyard! With my name on it! It's LAMINATED!
lines.script: [thrilled, shouts] A lanyard! With my name on it! It's LAMINATED!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Of course it's laminated. I wanted this to last.
lines.script: [warm, amused] Of course it's laminated. I wanted this to last.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Do I have to give it back?
lines.script: [shy, hopeful] Do I have to give it back?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Never. Where I go, you go. That's Deedee's rule. So stick close, babe, and don't leave me hanging like that fish.
lines.script: [tender] Never. Where I go, you go. That's Deedee's rule. [playful] So stick close, babe, and don't leave me HANGING like that fish.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Very, very important. I have a lanyard. And now so do you.
lines.script: [mock serious, proud] Very, VERY important. I have a lanyard. [warm] And now so do you.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: She has to come. Nobody goes anywhere alone. Does she get a lanyard?
lines.script: [earnest] She has to come. Nobody goes anywhere alone. [hopeful] Does SHE get a lanyard?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I only had one spare badge.
lines.script: [easy, apologetic] I only had one spare badge.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It says STUNT DOUBLE. Whose stunt double is she?
lines.script: [delighted, curious] It says STUNT DOUBLE. Whose stunt double is she?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: The horse's.
lines.script: [deadpan] The horse's.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nara! You're in the movies!
lines.script: [thrilled, loud] Nara! You're in the MOVIES!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Hello, Ray. I'm Tom. I'm a visitor. It says so right here.
lines.script: [polite, proud] Hello, Ray. I'm Tom. I'm a visitor. [pleased] It says so right HERE.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: He didn't even look at it.
lines.script: [quiet, crestfallen] He didn't even look at it.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: He never looks. But you held it up beautifully.
lines.script: [warm, consoling] He never looks. [sincere] But you held it up BEAUTIFULLY.

lines.speaker: Kiki
lines.text: It was right there in Stage 7. Then there was a HUGE flash, and the fog machine turned itself on, and the lights went out, and things started CLAPPING.
lines.script: [frantic, rushed] It was right there in Stage 7. Then there was a HUGE flash, and the fog machine turned itself on, and the lights went out, and things started CLAPPING.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A flash! What kind of flash?
lines.script: [sharp, alarmed] A flash! What KIND of flash?

lines.speaker: Kiki
lines.text: I thought it was lightning for the storm scene. We don't HAVE a storm scene!
lines.script: [frantic] I thought it was lightning for the storm scene. [shrill, panicked] We don't HAVE a storm scene!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I've seen grumpy things like that! On my street, and at my parents' pond. They always show up right after a flash.
lines.script: [serious, quick] I've seen grumpy things like that! On my street, and at my parents' pond. They always show up right after a flash.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: You've seen them before? Wonderful. You're hired.
lines.script: [brisk, relieved] You've seen them before? Wonderful. [snappy] You're hired.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I'm hired! I've been a visitor for one hour!
lines.script: [amazed, delighted] I'm HIRED! I've been a visitor for one hour!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: She's the stunt double! She has a badge!
lines.script: [defensive, proud] She's the stunt double! She has a BADGE!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You can tell it's grape from one sniff?
lines.script: [amazed, amused] You can tell it's grape from ONE sniff?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe. I'd know grape anywhere. It's my favorite color and my favorite flavor.
lines.script: [warm, certain] Babe. I'd know grape anywhere. [playful] It's my favorite color AND my favorite flavor.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Stage 7 is locked from the inside, though. And every set out here has one of those grumpy things on it, wrecking the shoot. The crew can't work like this.
lines.script: [worried, practical] Stage 7 is locked from the inside, though. And every set out here has one of those grumpy things on it, wrecking the shoot. The crew can't work like this.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Then we get them off the sets, one at a time: Main Street, the Western street and New York. After that we deal with Stage 7.
lines.script: [calm, determined] Then we get them off the sets, one at a time: Main Street, the Western street and New York. [firm] After that we deal with Stage 7.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That crab is made of cue cards! And it's holding one up for us to read!
lines.script: [amazed, delighted] That crab is made of cue cards! And it's holding one up for us to READ!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Excuse me, Mr. Crab. Do you have a card that says PLEASE COME IN?
lines.script: [polite, hopeful] Excuse me, Mr. Crab. Do you have a card that says PLEASE COME IN?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe, I think we're on the wrong side of the cards.
lines.script: [wry, playful] Babe, I think we're on the wrong side of the CARDS.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: He goes first? All right. Rules are rules. Where's my mark? I'd like to stand on my mark.
lines.script: [earnest] He goes first? All right. Rules are rules. [eager] Where's my mark? I'd like to stand on my MARK.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe, you're not in the movie.
lines.script: [gentle, amused] Babe, you're not IN the movie.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I have a lanyard!
lines.script: [proud, loud] I have a LANYARD!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Stand down, Nara. The horse is doing his own stunts today.
lines.script: [firm, amused] Stand down, Nara. The horse is doing his OWN stunts today.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I like the click. That's how I know you're home.
lines.script: [warm, softly] I like the click. That's how I know you're home.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Cover your ears, babe. When a boom mic screeches, nobody can get a word out.
lines.script: [urgent, practical] Cover your ears, babe. When a boom mic screeches, nobody can get a word out.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's very dark in here. Could you hold my lanyard?
lines.script: [quiet, anxious] It's very dark in here. [short pause] [polite] Could you hold my lanyard?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I've got your lanyard, babe.
lines.script: [warm, gentle] I've got your lanyard, babe.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Blue, orange, red. And one strip of gaffer tape. Okay, two. Okay, four.
lines.script: [easy, confident] Blue, orange, red. And ONE strip of gaffer tape. [sheepish] Okay, two. [quietly] Okay, four.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You fixed a whole soundstage with tape! Can you fix my knees?
lines.script: [impressed] You fixed a whole soundstage with TAPE! [hopeful, playful] Can you fix my knees?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Hold on. One of the lights must still be out. That whole patch of floor is grey.
lines.script: [puzzled, easy] Hold on. One of the lights must still be out. That whole patch of floor is grey.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's not the lights. Look up. Every one of them is on.
lines.script: [quiet, certain] It's not the lights. Look up. Every one of them is ON.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Then why is my table grey? And the floor? And my tape marks?
lines.script: [confused] Then why is my table grey? [anxious, speeding up] And the floor? And my tape marks?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Babe. That's the hero hat. The cowboy wears it in every scene of the movie. And it's inside a big orange block!
lines.script: [startled] Babe. That's the hero hat. The cowboy wears it in every scene of the movie. [disbelief, louder] And it's inside a big orange BLOCK!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's just like the dragonfly, the lemon and the fish. And every one is bigger than the last.
lines.script: [uneasy, awed] It's just like the dragonfly, the lemon and the fish. [slowly] And every one is BIGGER than the last.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Well, hats off to whoever did this. No, really. I can't get the hat off.
lines.script: [rattled, wry] Well, hats off to whoever did this. [short pause] [flat, anxious] No, really. I can't get the hat OFF.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: There's going to be a little round hole in the side.
lines.script: [calm, certain] There's going to be a little round hole in the side.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: There it is.
lines.script: [calm, satisfied] There it is.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: And there's going to be a burnt flashbulb on the floor, somewhere close.
lines.script: [calm, certain] And there's going to be a burnt flashbulb on the floor, somewhere close.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: You knew exactly where to look. Babe, how are you this good at it?
lines.script: [amazed, uneasy] You knew exactly where to look. Babe, how are you this GOOD at it?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I've had three practices. And I've lost a pulling contest to a plum, a grapefruit and a watermelon. I'm not pulling on a beach ball.
lines.script: [matter-of-fact] I've had three practices. [dry, resigned] And I've lost a pulling contest to a plum, a grapefruit and a watermelon. [firm] I'm NOT pulling on a beach ball.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Then I'll just move the table.
lines.script: [determined, easy] Then I'll just move the table.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I moved the table. The hat didn't come with it.
lines.script: [stunned, quiet] I moved the table. [short pause] The hat didn't come WITH it.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's what the fish does!
lines.script: [excited, amazed] That's what the FISH does!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I don't like it. Put the table back. I want the table back under it right now.
lines.script: [rattled] I don't like it. Put the table back. [pleading, speeding up] I want the table back under it right NOW.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Thank you. That's better. That's a hat on a table. That's normal.
lines.script: [relieved, shaky] Thank you. That's better. [reassuring, slowly] That's a hat on a table. That's NORMAL.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Hat: grey floor, orange block, round hole, burnt bulb. I'm sending it to Amy for Grace. She keeps the list in her notebook.
lines.script: [precise, steady] Hat: grey floor, orange block, round hole, burnt bulb. [matter-of-fact] I'm sending it to Amy for Grace. She keeps the list in her notebook.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Who brings a flashbulb onto a movie set? We have four hundred lights in here and not one of them is that.
lines.script: [baffled, uneasy] Who brings a flashbulb onto a movie set? We have four hundred lights in here and not ONE of them is that.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: That came from the stage set. And that's where the wheel tracks go.
lines.script: [alert, low] That came from the stage set. And that's where the wheel tracks go.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That megaphone is as big as a refrigerator! And it's sitting on your costumes!
lines.script: [startled, shouts] That megaphone is as big as a REFRIGERATOR! And it's sitting on your costumes!

lines.speaker: The Director’s Cut
lines.text: This morning there was a big flash down on the floor. Now I'm big enough to do my own yelling.
lines.script: [booming, bossy] This morning there was a big flash down on the floor. Now I'm big enough to do my OWN yelling.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Excuse me, sir. Those are his costumes. He steamed all forty by hand. While humming.
lines.script: [polite, firm] Excuse me, sir. Those are his costumes. He steamed all forty by hand. [short pause] [earnest] While humming.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: And look at the beret. That's a gold coin.
lines.script: [quiet, curious] And look at the beret. That's a gold coin.

lines.speaker: The Director’s Cut
lines.text: That's my AWARD. I found it on the floor. Forty years on this lot, and it's my first one.
lines.script: [booming, defensive] That's my AWARD. I found it on the floor. [proud, quieter] Forty years on this lot, and it's my first one.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: We are. We have lanyards.
lines.script: [firm, proud] We are. We have LANYARDS.

lines.speaker: The Director’s Cut
lines.text: If I can get a "great take", somebody else should get the award. Best costumes. It goes to the skinny one with the tape.
lines.script: [booming, softened] If I can get a "great take", somebody else should get the award. [generous, loud] Best costumes. It goes to the skinny one with the tape.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I've never won anything! I'd like to thank my steamer. I'd like to thank my tape.
lines.script: [overwhelmed, delighted] I've never won ANYTHING! [earnest] I'd like to thank my steamer. I'd like to thank my tape.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: And I'd like to thank my babe, who flew two thousand four hundred and seventy-five miles to watch me work.
lines.script: [tender, emotional] And I'd like to thank my babe, who flew two thousand four hundred and seventy-five miles to watch me work.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: He said the right number!
lines.script: [thrilled, proud] He said the RIGHT number!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It has a cowboy hat on it. Rose has a dragonfly, I have a lemon, and my father has a fish.
lines.script: [quiet, amazed] It has a cowboy hat on it. Rose has a dragonfly, I have a lemon, and my father has a fish.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: And now I have a hat. Babe, I love my award. I don't love that there are four of them.
lines.script: [happy] And now I have a hat. Babe, I LOVE my award. [uneasy, quietly] I don't love that there are four of them.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: It's not a frisbee, Nara. It's an award.
lines.script: [gentle, amused] It's not a frisbee, Nara. It's an AWARD.

lines.speaker: The Director’s Cut
lines.text: The lighting was too flat. Nobody asked me. But it was.
lines.script: [booming, grumpy] The lighting was too flat. [quieter, grumbling] Nobody asked me. But it was.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Help me push. This thing has four wheels and four opinions.
lines.script: [easy, amused] Help me push. This thing has four wheels and four OPINIONS.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: The hero hat is still stuck in there. Good thing wardrobe always has a double.
lines.script: [wry, easy] The hero hat is still stuck in there. Good thing wardrobe always has a DOUBLE.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A backup hat! You're the most prepared man I know. And I set two alarms for everything.
lines.script: [amazed, proud] A backup hat! You're the most prepared man I know. [short pause] [earnest] And I set two alarms for everything.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I always keep one under my hat.
lines.script: [deadpan, playful] I always keep one under my HAT.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Finders keepers. I'm calling it best costumes.
lines.script: [cheerful, easy] Finders keepers. I'm calling it best costumes.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Two awards in one day, babe. I'm on a hot steam streak.
lines.script: [proud, playful] Two awards in one day, babe. I'm on a hot STEAM streak.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: And crew jackets. Wrap Party Jackets. Only the crew gets one. You're crew now. Even the stunt double.
lines.script: [warm, brisk] And crew jackets. Wrap Party Jackets. Only the crew gets one. You're crew now. [dry] Even the stunt double.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A second lanyard! I have TWO lanyards!
lines.script: [thrilled, shouts] A second lanyard! I have TWO lanyards!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Steam-ulating! I flew two thousand four hundred and seventy-five miles for that pun.
lines.script: [delighted] STEAM-ulating! [amused, exasperated] I flew two thousand four hundred and seventy-five miles for that pun.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Worth it. Every mile. I'd have flown them for zero puns.
lines.script: [warm, tender] Worth it. Every mile. [softly] I'd have flown them for zero puns.

lines.speaker: Toni
lines.text: Not next to the cake! ...Fine. She's crew.
lines.script: [alarmed] Not next to the CAKE! [softening, grudging] ...Fine. She's crew.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It's Amy. "Grace put the hat on page three. Also, parent-teacher conference night is Thursday. Thirty parents. I need backup. Bring snacks. And bring the good uncle."
lines.script: [amused] It's Amy. [precise, steady] "Grace put the hat on page three. Also, parent-teacher conference night is Thursday. Thirty parents. I need backup. Bring snacks. [dry] And bring the GOOD uncle."

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Go. But nobody goes anywhere alone, so take my picture for the plane.
lines.script: [warm] Go. [playful] But nobody goes anywhere alone, so take my PICTURE for the plane.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's the one I'm looking at for six hours.
lines.script: [softly, happy] That's the one I'm looking at for six hours.
